description.value:
The calm is the discipline.

Mode: Protector

Stillheart Aurablades hold the aura instead of feeding it. Heat arrives by stillness rather than damage; the doctrine extends safety outward, denies panic to the people you stand near, and refuses disruption when the field starts to fray.

Doctrine Features

  • Level 3 — Centered Breath. Once per encounter, the overheat cannot bite you. Once per round when you would gain Surge you may let it go instead. Allies within 2 squares reroll the lowest die on their first check vs fear or charm each scene.
  • Level 6 — Shared Aura. Extend stability outward. While you hold Surge but aren't Overheated, allies within 2 squares gain half your Aura's passive benefit (Fury: +1 dmg once/turn; Resolve: +1 Guard while stationary; Mercy: free nonlethal choice; Dread: reroll the lowest die against fear).
  • Level 10 — Quiet Mind. You and allies within 2 squares are immune to being Shaken and reroll the lowest die on checks against charm, confusion, or fear. While Stoked or hotter you may spend your reaction to cancel one fear or charm effect on an ally.
  • Level 14 — Emotional Lock. Your Aura cannot be forcibly changed. As a bonus action, until the start of your next turn the overheat can't touch you (no Stress from a full Surge bank). While Stoked or hotter you may also ignore one backlash trigger entirely.
  • Level 18 — Eye of the Storm (Capstone). Once per Soma Break, for 1 minute in a 4 squares radius: Surge does not rise for you or allies; fear, charm, and fear effects are suppressed; ongoing emotional effects pause. After it ends, you gain 1 Surge.
